intro.text: A chasmfiend who allied with the listeners after the War of Reckoning.

items.text: Skyblue belongs to the group of chasmfiends, led by Thundercloud, that made peace with the listeners. At the Second Battle of Narak they staged a mock attack on the human defences; Skyblue was given the task of destroying the gate between two plateaus while leaving the humans' bridge intact so they could flee to the Oathgate.
